description: This file defines function prototypes and forward declarations related to managing 'islands' in a version control system, likely for delta compression purposes in a Git-like repository. It includes functions for comparing commits, resolving tree islands, loading island data, propagating island marks, and computing pack layers.

methods.name: island_delta_cmp
methods.description: Compares two object IDs to determine if they belong to the same island or to order them.

methods.name: in_same_island
methods.description: Checks if two object IDs are part of the same island.

methods.name: resolve_tree_islands
methods.description: Resolves the islands within a repository, possibly involving traversing commits and trees.

methods.name: load_delta_islands
methods.description: Loads island data for delta compression in the repository.

methods.name: propagate_island_marks
methods.description: Propagates island markings through commits in the repository.

methods.name: compute_pack_layers
methods.description: Calculates the layering of pack data based on islands.

methods.name: free_island_marks
methods.description: Frees memory associated with island markings.
